{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {len(df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999])}")

# Check sample_seq for re-testing
print(f"Max sample_seq: {df['sample_seq'].max()}")

# Check if any patient has multiple sample_seq
patient_sample_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].count()
print(f"Patients with multiple sample_seq: {patient_sample_counts[patient_sample_counts > 1].count()}")"}
